name: chimney_floor_jumps
chapter: Core mechanics: jumps at a wall from the floor: a standing jump is no wall jump, a stick jump plants her feet (docs/GAMEPLAY.md Chimney jumps, docs/REFERENCE_COMPARISON.md M06)
note: l2_junglehub, the streambed between the square columns: column A's unflagged east face is 111 west of her. tru.exe under Wine at this spot: a plain standing jump, apex 201.6 (the jump query q2 carries flag 0x80: tru.exe 0x7594C0 returns 0).

expect.note: she does not plant her feet on the column

steps.note: tru.exe under Wine (chimney3-wine.txt j3 / j4): a stick jump (q43) at this face puts her in the wall state one frame after the take-off, her root 43.2 / 43.6 over the floor (ours 47.1: one 30 Hz frame of the 49.97 take-off); with no press she stays 0.62 s (ours 0.47 s: the draw onto the wall is 4 frames shorter) and comes down to the floor.
